description: READ THIS BEFORE POSTING ANY CARD to the approval hub (POST /pending) or acting on a verdict. Compiled from HUB-CARD-CONTRACT.md; never edit by hand.
usage: Read this before every POST /pending. The hub's guard also applies the patterns in hub-rules.json, but the guard only catches what a regex can see; these rules are the rest.

Feedback on a card (a reply, a rejection with a reason, a comment on the review page) goes to the feedback session, which files it in the ledger; this file is its compile (`rules/compile_skill.py --contract hub --install`).
In front: what the hit counts say is still needed. Assumed: still checked, back in front the moment it fires.
procedure: Decide first whether a card should exist at all ({R:outbound}, {R:no-reconfirm}).
Give it an idem key so a re-post edits it in place ({R:once}).
Line one: decision or update, and what ({R:first-line}); then the artifact itself ({R:artifact}).

rules.rule: Anything that leaves the system toward another person needs a card; the hub sends on yes, a session never sends itself.
rules.example: a reply to a supplier: draft written, card posted with action {type: "email-send-draft", draft_id}, sent by the hub on yes

rules.rule: What the owner already instructed is reported as kind update, never asked again.
rules.example: "done: the calendar slots you asked for are blocked" (update), not "block the calendar slots?"

rules.rule: A card pings once: re-posts carry the same idem key and edit in place; same producer + person + action supersedes.
rules.example: meta {idem: "followup:person-42"} on every revision of the same follow-up

rules.rule: Line one says decision or update and what exactly; a non-urgent card says when it would become urgent.
rules.example: "Send the revised quote to the supplier? Not urgent before Friday."

rules.rule: The artifact is on the card: the whole draft, the recipient, the subject.
rules.example: a draft card with To, Subject and the body in a collapsed quote

rules.rule: One card, one decision; unrelated asks are separate cards.
